title: SAID Agent Identity
summary: Give an AI agent an on-chain identity, pay to verify it, stake SOL behind it and collect feedback, validations and receipt anchors.
what: SAID is an Anchor 0.32.1 identity standard for agents: an identity PDA per owner, a paid verified badge, slashable stake, peer feedback, third-party work validations and sequential merkle anchors of the agent’s receipts.
app_note: The page at /dapps/said/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/said. The lab changed declare_id and set TREASURY_AUTHORITY to the Sol.College devnet deployer.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/said/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call register_agent with an https:// metadata URI.
try_steps.see: Your identity PDA ["agent", your wallet], unverified.
try_steps.ran: The full identity, stake, feedback, slash and unstake flow (see steps).

diagram: owner --register_agent--> identity; owner --get_verified--> treasury (+0.01 SOL); owner --stake--> stake PDA; reviewer --submit_feedback--> reputation; validator --validate_work--> record; admin --slash_agent--> stake -> treasury; owner --emergency_unstake--> 90% back
innovation: One account ties together an agent’s identity, economic stake, peer reputation and an auditable receipt trail.
exercises: Why must receipt anchors be strictly sequential?
What does the 10% emergency-unstake penalty protect against?
